top_signals.title: Analysis: AI sell-off leaves markets at a crossroad
top_signals.summary: A rout in AI and tech stocks has wiped trillions off global markets. For City AM’s Midday Markets newsletter, Ali Lyon chews over what it all means. It’s been one of those mornings when analysts have woken up and reached for their morbid bon mots of choice. “Bloodbath” has proven popular. So too, “capitulation-level event” [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
